condition: Paired on reference or economics; quantity and settle date agree; amount difference above tolerance.
action: Compare booked price and fees with the broker confirmation; amend the booking or raise a claim.

condition: Paired (or near-matched) records disagree on quantity.
action: Check execution report; amend booked quantity or chase the missing fill.

condition: Same trade economics but the settle (value) date differs.
action: Confirm the settlement cycle with the custodian and amend the value date on the wrong side.

condition: Non-base-currency trade; amount difference within the FX band (1.5-5 bp).
action: Confirm the FX rate source; if within policy, propose a write-off for checker approval.

condition: Internal booking with no custodian record and no near-match.
action: Chase the custodian / broker for confirmation; most arrive within 1-3 business days.

condition: Custodian record with no internal booking and no near-match.
action: Search for the booking under other accounts; book the trade if genuine.

condition: Internal row identical to an earlier internal row except for its ID.
action: Cancel the later booking after confirming only one execution took place.
